shots.prompt: 5-second 16:9 realistic close-detail shot. Use image 1 for the initial cup and right-hand arrangement and image 2 for the final gentle contact pose. One speckled ivory ceramic cup rests flat in the same place on the wooden table. Its handle is on the right, with one small blue dot at the lower handle join. A single right hand in a dark-gray knitted sleeve begins with a small gap between fingertips and handle. After a brief pause, the thumb and index fingertip move a short distance to gently touch the top of the handle, then rest there for the remaining time. The cup remains on the table throughout, tea level steady. The camera and focus stay fixed; show the hand contact and cup base clearly. Preserve the same cup, tabletop, daylight from the left, natural skin and ceramic texture. A small ordinary touch followed by an unhurried pause. Continuous quiet room tone with a soft ceramic contact and fabric sound. Keep the scene free of text and music.
shots.promptZhTranslation: 5 秒、16:9 的写实细节近景。图 1 用于开始时杯子和右手的布局，图 2 用于最后轻触的姿态。一只米白斑点陶杯平放在木桌同一位置；把手在右，下连接处有一个蓝点。唯一一只穿深灰针织袖的右手，开始时指尖与杯柄之间留有小空隙。短暂停顿后，拇指与食指指尖小幅移动，轻轻触到把手上部，然后保持到结束。杯子全程落在桌面，茶水保持水平。摄影机和焦点固定，看清手部接触与杯底。保留同一杯子、桌面、左侧日光、自然皮肤与陶面质感。一个日常小动作，随后不匆忙地停留。连续安静室内底噪，配以轻触陶杯和衣料声。画面没有文字，声音没有音乐。
shots.title: 触到日常
plannedCheck: 先检查接触点、手指数量、杯足落桌，再检查轻触后的停顿是否可读。

shots.title: 走向窗边
shots.prompt: 5 seconds, 16:9. Image 1 is the same person, cup, room and rear-follow composition reference at the beginning of a carrying stride. Image 2 supplies ONLY the relaxed stopped posture and both-feet-planted state; do NOT lock its background camera position or morph the entire picture into it. Keep the same short-haired adult in dark-gray knit, dark trousers and dark slippers, back to camera with no visible face. The right hand holds the same cup HANDLE continuously, left palm supports the BASE from below, cup upright in front of lower chest, tea not spilling. Continue for TWO short natural steps toward the same window over roughly the first three seconds, then settle with both feet planted and pause for the final two seconds. Stop before the wall/window at a comfortable distance. No drinking, lifting cup to face, backward steps, turning to camera, extra gesture, sliding feet or duplicate cup. Follow smoothly from behind at a gentle rear-three-quarter angle, advancing in the person's direction at roughly matching speed, then stop the camera when the person stops. Keep the person screen right and at roughly constant readable size; show legs and ground contacts where possible. The window remains ahead/left, the worn wooden table stays left, and cabinet stays right. Preserve real perspective change and foreground parallax as the camera advances: no zoom, orbit, room mirroring, object drift or moving the window to fake travel. Keep the same daylight, knit and ivory glaze; no dramatic grading or hurried pursuit. Let a clear destination and an unforced stop express the choice to take a moment. One continuous shot, no cut, generated text, logo, tears or exaggerated acting. Soft footsteps, fabric rustle and continuous quiet room tone only; no speech or music.
shots.promptZhTranslation: 5 秒，16:9。图 1 是同一人物、杯子、房间与端杯步态开始时的后方构图参考。图 2 只提供放松停步和双脚落地的姿态，不锁定它的背景机位，也不把整幅图变形过渡到该图。保持同一短发成人、深灰针织衣、深色裤子与拖鞋，背向镜头不露脸。右手持续握同一杯柄，左掌从下托住杯底；杯子直立放在身体前方下胸位置，茶水不洒。约前三秒继续朝同一扇窗自然走两个短步，然后双脚落地站稳，最后两秒停留。在窗／墙前的舒适距离停住。不喝茶、不举杯到脸前、不倒退、不转身看镜头、不加手势、不滑步、不增加杯子。摄影机从轻微后方三分之四角度平稳跟随，大致匹配人物速度向前，在人物停步时也停下。人物保持画面偏右和大致稳定的可辨大小，尽量看清腿与脚接地。窗户仍在前方／左侧，旧木桌在左，柜子在右。摄影机前进应有真实透视和前景视差，不变焦、环绕、镜像房间、漂移物体或移动窗户来假装行走。延续日光、针织和米白陶面，不加戏剧调色或追逐感。让明确目的地和自然停步表达主动留出片刻的选择。单一连续镜头，不切镜、不生成文字或标志，不哭泣或夸张表演。只有轻脚步、衣料声和连续安静室内底噪，无人声和音乐。
shots.referenceRole: 图1人物／杯子／场景与步态构图，图2仅为停步姿态；不锁定图2背景机位
plannedCheck: 完整检查两步、脚底接地、杯子双手支撑与停稳；区分摄影机真实跟随与固定机位下人物远去。

shots.title: 留住片刻
shots.prompt: 5 seconds, 16:9. Use the supplied close window-pause image as the FIRST FRAME and wider room view as the END FRAME. The same person has ALREADY STOPPED at the window. Keep that person and the single speckled ivory cup stationary in the room for the entire shot, with only subtle natural breathing. Right hand stays on the handle and left palm supports the base; the tea stays level. Keep the one blue dot at the lower handle attachment; if the grip hides it, leave it hidden instead of inventing a mark on the cup front. NO additional steps, drinking, cup raising, head turn, slumping or new gesture. Move ONLY the CAMERA backward on a smooth dolly at a FIXED FOCAL LENGTH during roughly seconds 0–3, revealing more of the same window corner, wooden table at foreground left, floor and cabinet at right. Then LOCK the camera and hold the wider view for roughly seconds 3–5. Preserve coherent perspective/parallax and room geography; do not zoom, orbit, warp furniture, shrink the person's body in place or move the window to imitate a dolly. Keep a readable human presence, relaxed upright body and ordinary lived-in room rather than an isolated tiny silhouette. Maintain the same window daylight and exterior green leaves, with restrained texture and detail in interior shadows. This chosen pause and the held final view should support quiet personal time, without asking for sad acting. One continuous shot, no cuts, fake text, logo, magical particles or new objects. Continuous quiet room tone and slight clothing sound only, no speech or music. Do not generate a title or fade; those are added in editing if needed.
shots.promptZhTranslation: 5 秒，16:9。所给窗边停留近景为首帧，较宽房间画面为尾帧。同一人物已经在窗前停稳，全镜中人物与同一只米白斑点陶杯在房间里保持不动，只保留自然细微呼吸。右手持续持柄，左掌托底，茶水保持水平。把手下连接处只有一个蓝点；被手遮住就自然遮挡，不在杯身正面凭空补标记。不再走步、喝茶、举杯、转头、垂头或加手势。约 0–3 秒只让摄影机以固定焦距平稳后退，逐步露出同一窗边、左前景木桌、地板和右侧柜子；约 3–5 秒机位固定，保持宽景。维持连贯的透视、视差和房间方位，不变焦、环绕、扭曲家具、让人物原地缩小或移动窗户来假装后拉。人物仍清楚可辨、姿态放松直立，房间仍有日常生活感，不缩成孤立的小剪影。延续窗户日光与窗外绿叶，质感克制，室内暗部保留细节。通过主动停留与最终保持的画面，表达属于自己的安静时间，不要求悲伤表演。单一连续镜头，不切镜，不加假文字、标志、魔法粒子或新物体。只有连续安静室内底噪和少量衣料声，无人声和音乐。不要生成片名或淡出，需要时在后期完成。
shots.referenceRole: 窗边近景→房间宽景构图；主体停留，只有摄影机后退
plannedCheck: 核对人物始终不走动、空间不变形、摄影机真实后退，并观察后段是否实际停住。
